preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices ai and bi, where 1 ≤ ai < bi ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= m for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has a color ci, where 1 ≤ ci ≤ m.
The number of edges provided is exactly m.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and ui != vi for ui, vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two distinct vertices ui and vi, where 1 ≤ ui, vi ≤ n and ui ≠ vi.
The number of queries provided is exactly q.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= m for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output value is an integer between 0 and m inclusive, representing the number of colors connecting the queried vertices.
